props.title: Digital Twin
props.sub: the layer of live senses — the graph, synchronized with reality

props.kicker: WHAT MAKES A GRAPH A TWIN
props.title: Three ingredients turn a static map into a living one

cards.head: Structure
cards.body: The knowledge graph — every entity and relationship in your system.

cards.head: Live state
cards.body: Telemetry streams — logs, metrics, DB state — updating node properties continuously.

cards.head: Simulation
cards.body: Run what-if changes over the graph before you touch production.

props.foot: Twin = knowledge graph + live telemetry + the ability to simulate. Not a 3D render — a live model.
A model that mirrors reality now — not a diagram someone drew last quarter.

props.title: Change events flow in and update the graph in seconds
props.foot: Change-data-capture on the DBs plus a log stream keep the model within seconds of reality.

props.title: Twins climb from ‘what is’ to ‘act on its own’
props.foot: Most teams live on rungs one and two. The top rung is where agents plug in.

props.title: Who runs digital twins today

cards.head: Industry & energy
cards.body: Factories, jet engines, and power grids — the original, hard-ROI twins.

cards.head: Cities & buildings
cards.body: Traffic, utilities, and whole ‘digital city’ models used for planning.

cards.head: Software & data
cards.body: The newest frontier: a live twin of your systems, pipelines, and services — ours.

props.foot: Any complex system you can model as a graph, you can twin — including your software.

props.title: Real digital-twin tech, from IT systems to physical factories

cards.head: Azure Digital Twins
cards.body: Model in DTDL (JSON-LD), build a live graph in the cloud. Natural fit for our Azure stack.

cards.head: Eclipse Ditto
cards.body: Open-source twins for fleets of IoT devices, with clean JSON APIs.

cards.head: Asset Admin Shell
cards.body: The Industry-4.0 & ISO 23247 standard for twins of machines and plants.

cards.head: NVIDIA Omniverse
cards.body: OpenUSD-based twins for physical AI — factories, robots, ‘the $50T opportunity’.

props.foot: Our project maps cleanly onto Azure Digital Twins + DTDL — same ontology idea, twin-flavored.

props.title: A twin of your data pipeline = live data observability

cards.head: Freshness
cards.body: Every table node carries ‘last updated’. A stale report becomes visible before any human notices it's wrong.

cards.head: Lineage
cards.body: source → table → query → report is already in the graph. That IS column-level data lineage, for free.

cards.head: Data contracts
cards.body: SHACL on the twin enforces the schema a downstream report was promised — a broken contract fails loudly.

props.foot: For a reporting platform like ours, the twin doubles as a live data-quality cockpit.

props.title: Four payoffs that justify the build

cards.head: Faster incidents
cards.body: Root cause in minutes, not hours — the RCA agent we build in part five.

cards.head: Safer changes
cards.body: Simulate blast radius before shipping — no more 2 a.m. surprises.

cards.head: Instant onboarding
cards.body: New engineers ask the graph how the system fits together — and get a real answer.

cards.head: Trustworthy AI
cards.body: A grounded world model is what lets an agent act without hallucinating.

props.foot: Every payoff here is something a stakeholder can feel — that's how the project gets funded.

props.title: Palantir's leap: a live twin of the whole organization

cards.head: Beyond IT
cards.body: Not just servers and tables — orders, shipments, customers and decisions become live objects too.

cards.head: Semantic + kinetic
cards.body: Things you can see, plus the actions you can take, unified in one governed model.

cards.head: Humans + agents share it
cards.body: The same operational twin is the workspace for people and AI alike — one source of truth.

props.foot: The horizon: your business itself, as a living, queryable, actionable model.
Simulate the blast radius on the twin, instead of discovering it in production at 2 a.m.
